sn52.11:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam āyasmā Anuruddho Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme || || 2--3.
sn52.11:1.2: Atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū yenāyasmā Anuruddho tenupasaṅkamiṃsu || upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā Anuruddhena saddhiṃ || la-pe || āyasmantam || Anuruddham etad avocuṃ || ||
sn52.11:2.1: Katamesam āyasmā Anuruddho dhammānam bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā mahābhiññatam patto ti ||
sn52.11:2.2: Catunnaṃ khvāham āvuso || pe || mahābhiññatam patto ||
sn52.11:2.7: dhammesu dhammānupassī viharāmi ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyyaloke abhijjhādomanassaṃ || ||
sn52.11:2.8: Imesaṃ khvāham āvuso catunnaṃ satipaṭṭhānānam bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā mahābhiññatam patto || || 5.
sn52.11:2.9: Imesañ ca panāham āvuso catunnaṃ satipaṭṭhānānam bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā kappasahassam anussarāmī ti || || 5.
